items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Johnny, Carney, Procop, they joined over there in Joppa 55.

ctx.x: Well, which lodge were those people like Johnny Hodges in?

Johnny belonged to Joppa 55 -- Johnny, Carney, Procop, they joined over there in Joppa 55. They the one that gave Duke, his a masonic funeral too because Duke's mother lodge was in Washington, D. C., but most all these fellows here, they're all living except some that deceased (unintelligible) on the communication, but most of the big ones outside of Joppa -- but Harlem Lodge carry more than anybody. I guess about all the doctors up there together, about 30 some lodges.
